# Copilot Instructions

This repository is both the Symphony reference implementation and an agentic research/governance hub.

Start with:

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `docs/memory/INDEX.md`
3. `docs/memory/handoff.md`
4. `docs/systems/INDEX.md`

For research-heavy work, use `.agents/skills/research-brief` and keep claims source-grounded.

For changes under `elixir/`, follow `elixir/AGENTS.md` and run the relevant Elixir checks.

Never commit real secrets. Use `.env.example` for names only.
